name: Gumroad
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Gumroad, sell a few digital files through Stripe Checkout and a user-owned delivery page. The hard boundary is buyer familiarity, payment operations, tax handling, discovery, and creator workflow, plus payments, tax, distribution, and operations.
